address: 6F, The Rees Hotel, 377 Frankton Road, Queenstown, 9300, New Zealand
bio: With lake and mountain views, the intimate space is perfect for romantic dates and celebrations. The chef works closely with local farmers and fishermen to secure the freshest ingredients. He also grows his own hops and uses them in dishes such as local line-caught ika mata – the fish is cured in hop-infused kiwi juice and topped with a coconut foam, for refreshing flavours and bitter notes. The wine list features premium by-the-glass choices.
